evidence.title: GitHub - TheOrcDev/4elements: 3d test for different AI models

name: 4 Elements
summary: Local-first benchmark playground that compares AI models building the same interactive 3D elemental scene.
description: A local-first benchmark for AI-generated interactive 3D scenes. Every model gets the same brief — fire, water, earth and air rendered in real time in the browser — and ships a complete, self-contained WebGL app; the playground switches between 22 model builds (Opus 5, Grok 4.7, GPT-6 Sol, Gemini 3.8 Flash …) so you can compare them side by side.
contains: 22 model apps, one per AI model, all built from the same brief
brief: fire, water, earth and air as real-time 3D scenes
build times from 4m 26s to 3h 32m at each model's max reasoning
each app keeps its own Three.js version and is loaded in an iframe
